title: python test env: jsonschema declared in dev group but absent from uv sync env; test_tofu_edge_vectors.py fails collection
description: uv run --directory python --group dev pytest tests/crypto/ fails collection on tests/crypto/test_tofu_edge_vectors.py: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'jsonschema', even though python/pyproject.toml dev group declares jsonschema>=4.26,<5. Reproduces on a clean tree (verified via git stash). Likely stale uv.lock or env synced without the dev group. Fix: refresh uv.lock / sync dev group so documented pytest invocations work.
